capability.name: Transparency-log checkpoint check: log signature, witness quorum, proofs
capability.description: Checks a transparency-log checkpoint (c2sp.org/tlog-checkpoint signed note: Go checksum database, Rekor v2, Tessera logs, HISTOR) against the log's verifier key and the witness keys you trust: the log's Ed25519 signature, each cosignature/v1 with its time, and whether your quorum of witnesses is met. Optionally an RFC 9162 inclusion proof (is this entry in the tree) and a consistency proof from an older checkpoint (did the log only grow). Returns valid or invalid with every reason. No network: the checkpoint and proofs come in the request.

witness_quorum.description: how many must have cosigned (default all)

now.description: Unix seconds, to judge cosignature times

note: a witnessed-log check for agents with no crypto library
